attributes.name: filename
attributes.description: Filename displayed in the toolbar and source editor; defaults to the src basename or the inline script filename when provided.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: Presentation mode: default and lite show the normal interface; simple opens the editor and hides the header and welcome information while retaining all query actions.

attributes.name: query
attributes.description: Initial query shown in the prompt and restored by Reset.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: External Prolog source file; takes precedence over value and the inline script. Changes take effect on Reset.

attributes.name: tracer
attributes.description: Enables recording the current program and query in a drawer initially 75% wide.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Prolog program consulted when the interpreter starts or resets; takes precedence over an inline script.

methods.name: accept(): Promise<void>
methods.description: Accepts the current answer and closes its remaining choice points.

methods.name: all(): Promise<void>
methods.description: Displays remaining answers when the prompt is unchanged or empty; otherwise executes the entered query.

methods.name: applySource(): Promise<void>
methods.description: Applies the editor source in a fresh session; Reset restores the authored program.

methods.name: clear(): void
methods.description: Clears the transcript while retaining the program and query history.

methods.name: getSource(): Promise<string>
methods.description: Returns the current program, including unsaved editor changes.

methods.name: loadLibrary(name: string): Promise<void>
methods.description: Loads a supported SWI-Prolog library, as from the libraries dropdown.

methods.name: next(): Promise<void>
methods.description: Requests the next answer without recomputing earlier solutions.

methods.name: openTrace(): Promise<void>
methods.description: Records the current program and query in a drawer initially 75% wide.

methods.name: reset(): Promise<void>
methods.description: Discards session changes and reloads the initial program in a fresh interpreter.

methods.name: run(source = this.input?.value ?? this.query): Promise<void>
methods.description: Reloads changed source, then executes a query and displays its first answer.

methods.name: toggleSource(): Promise<void>
methods.description: Shows or hides the editable Prolog source without changing the running session.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-prolog>` element provides an interactive Prolog interpreter.
userHelp.interactions:
The query buttons and Libraries dropdown remain available in all three modes, including simple mode and notebook cells.

#### Mouse interactions

| Action | Result |
| --- | --- |
| :tp-icon:{name="code" size="2em"} Edit source | Opens or hides the Prolog source editor below the toolbar. |
| :tp-icon:{name="prolog-tracer" library="components" size="2em"} Trace execution | When enabled, record the current program and query in a drawer initially 75% wide, without changing the interpreter session. |
| :tp-icon:{name="play" size="2em"} Run | Reload changed source, then execute the query and display its result. Keep the session when the source is unchanged. |
| :tp-icon:{name="next" size="2em"} Next solution ; | Requests the next solution of the current query. |
| :tp-icon:{name="play-all" size="2em"} All solutions | Runs the entered query and displays all its solutions; with an unchanged or empty prompt, displays the remaining solutions of the current query. Accept or Escape stops enumeration. |
| :tp-icon:{name="check" size="2em"} Accept . | Accepts the current answer and discards further solutions, keeping the query in the field. |
| :tp-icon:{name="delete-outline" size="2em"} Clear | Clears the transcript without changing the program or history. |
| :tp-icon:{name="file_type_swiprolog" library="languages" size="2em"} Libraries | Opens the library menu below the query field. Selecting a library runs use_module; a check marks loaded libraries. |
| :tp-icon:{name="refresh" size="2em"} Reset | Discards asserted facts and history and restores the initial program. |

Color, theme and fullscreen are provided by the toolbar controllers and apply only to this interpreter. Their own contextual help describes their commands.

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>;</kbd>, then <kbd>Enter</kbd> | Requests the next solution. |
| <kbd>.</kbd>, then <kbd>Enter</kbd>, or <kbd>Escape</kbd> | Accepts the current answer. |
| <kbd>ArrowUp</kbd> / <kbd>ArrowDown</kbd> | Recalls queries and restores the unfinished draft in the prompt; moves between library choices in the open menu. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> in Libraries | Opens the menu or loads the focused available library. |
| <kbd>Return</kbd> or <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Return</kbd> in the query field | Reload the program if its source changed, then run the current query. Keep the session if unchanged; retain the query text. An empty prompt accepts the current answer. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open contextual help for the component under the pointer or with focus; <kbd>Shift</kbd> may be needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Choose a component in the containing hierarchy and open its User help. |
